metadata.description: Open Content Studio's Claude-only version (v2-claude/): the whole studio as one free Claude plugin. Version 1, the full tool, lives in v1-tool/ and isn't a plugin.

plugins.name: studio
plugins.description: A free content studio inside Claude, from Mike Moll (mikemoll.co). Say quick start for your first carousel and posts in about 20 minutes; then episodes, clips and transcripts in, and reels, carousels, posts, post cards, covers, reviews, a review board and a posting calendar out, in your voice.
